scope: paired live article batching correctness comparison

shared_SQL_witness.query: WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM unnest($1::bigint[], $2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS q(viewer, slug, ord)), slugs AS (SELECT DISTINCT slug FROM r), e AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.id, a.slug, a.title, a.description, a.body, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.author_id, convert_to(array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT (SELECT t.name FROM tags t WHERE t.id = at.tag_id) FROM article_tags at WHERE at.article_id = a.id ORDER BY 1))::text, 'UTF8') AS tags, (SELECT count(*) FROM favorites f WHERE f.article_id = a.id) AS fc, u.username, u.bio, u.image FROM slugs JOIN articles a ON a.slug = slugs.slug JOIN users u ON u.id = a.author_id) SELECT e.slug, e.title, e.description, e.body, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.tags, e.fc, (r.viewer <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM favorites f WHERE f.article_id = e.id AND f.user_id = r.viewer)), e.username, e.bio, e.image, (r.viewer <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows fo WHERE fo.follower_id = r.viewer AND fo.followee_id = e.author_id)), r.ord FROM r JOIN e ON e.slug = r.slug ORDER BY r.ord
